title: Interrupted multi-step transaction (crash after seat reservation)
hypothesis: With idempotency keys + checkpoint recovery, a crash between 'seat reserved' and 'enrollment confirmed' produces no duplicate enrollments, no leaked seats and no lost acknowledged enrollments; baseline produces duplicates/orphans.
workload: Workload(rps=20, duration=40, read_ratio=0.7, client_retries=1, client_retry_delay=1.0, client_timeout=35.0, rps_steps=[])
fault: enrollment:0 hard-exits (os._exit) after reserving a seat, armed at t=10, 20, 30 s; restart policy ON in both modes to isolate the transaction mechanisms; client retries once with the same Idempotency-Key
